Iomart reports 8% revenue drop

Iomart has reported an 8% year-on-year decrease in revenue to £51.9m, from £56.3m.

The cloud computing company's trading update covered the first half of the financial year, ending 30 September, noted that the board was confident that short-term impacts on revenue will be reversed.

It explained that revenue was impacted by lower non-recurring equipment and consultancy sales, along with lower customer renewals.

Iomart’s profitability percentile remains stable, with an adjusted earnings before tax and profit before tax at 37.7% and 17.5% of revenue respectively, with the absolute reductions being at £1.2m and £700,000.

Cash flow in the period came in at £17.9m, after recognising write-offs of £4m during the period - down from £23.1m during the comparable period last year.

Reece Donovan, chief executive at Iomart, said: “Iomart’s high level of recurring revenue remains a considerable strength, providing good visibility for the remainder of the year - current trading is in line with the board’s expectations for the full year.”

Last week, the company agreed a new £100m revolving credit facility, replacing its £80m facility that was due to mature in September next year.

It plans to use the additional liquidity for working capital purposes and to fund investments, in accordance with a five-year strategic plan.

Glasgow Data Centre

Learn more about our


Data Centres


Our data centre is located approximately 5km from the heart of Glasgow city centre. It is built on a 0.7 acre site and was constructed especially for the purpose of large scale server hosting and colocation. It offers 768m² (8,266 ft²) of high quality, resilient and secure space, across two separate data halls.


Key Features

 * 24 hour manned security, CCTV and alarms
 * 24 hour on site Network Operations Centre (NOC)

 * Dual zone fire detection and suppression system

 * Carrier neutral

 * Controlled room temperature : 24°C +/- 2°C

Maximum Security

 * 24 x 7 x 365 manned security and monitoring
 * Smart card access policies
 * Internal and external CCTV systems
 * Security breach alarms


Power

 * Dual independent power feeds, backed up by dual battery string Uninterrupted Power Supplies (UPS) systems (deployed as standard)
 * 2 MW diesel generators - protect services from any single power failure


Technical Support & Services

 * On site technical engineers 24 x 7
 * All technicians are employed direct by Easyspace
 * On site Network Operations Centre (NOC)


Stable environmental Conditions

 * 24 x 7 environmental monitoring systems
 * Constant evaluation and testing of all systems
 * N+1 redundant Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC) system
 * Fully redundant air handling units provide constant fresh airflow
 * Raychem fluid detection
 * FM200 fire suppression equipment


Interconnectivity

 * Diverse fibre routing via multiple carriers
 * Truncated internal cable network
 * ODF/DDF (Optical Distribution Frame/Digital Distribution Frame) bandwidth
 * Cross Connection to a number of Tier 1 carriers
 * Internal inventory systems track all cables, circuits and cross-connects
 * Scalable architecture including multiple redundant core switches and routers


Our data centres


As part of the iomart Group, Easyspace owns and operates data centres at eight locations in the United Kingdom and has multiple Points of Presence around the world, all backed by our guaranteed service levels.

Our data centres are inter-connected via a high performance optical fibre network and, because we are carrier neutral, we can connect you onwards to multiple Tier 1 national and international carriers.

From the smallest requirement to the largest, Easyspace offers a full spectrum of solutions. Each of one of our UK and global data centres is totally secure, highly resilient and designed to cope with all computing demands.

Our expert team will work with you to build the hosting environment that best meets your business requirements, allowing you to take advantage of the huge growth in cloud computing wherever your business is located in the world.

Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly is the service activated?

On average, services are activated within 1 minute after payment. If the selected location is under high load, the process may take slightly longer.

Should I use a VDS for a game server?

For game servers, our managed hosting is the better choice. A VDS requires manual OS setup, security configuration, and ongoing maintenance. Our game hosting uses Pterodactyl with Docker containerization — it's pre-optimized, secured, and updated by us, so you can focus on the game.

What games and programming languages are supported?

We support 30+ games including Minecraft, Rust, CS2, Garry's Mod, Terraria, ARK, and many more. For coding plans, we support Python, Node.js, Java, Go, Rust, C#, Bun, Deno, and others. If your game or language isn't listed — contact us, and we'll add it.

Do you provide backups?

Yes, we provide backup functionality for most services. You can create and manage backups through the control panel. We recommend making regular backups to keep your data safe.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept international credit cards, SBP, cryptocurrency (via Morune & Cryptomus), Ukrainian cards, Google Pay, and Apple Pay (via Monobank P2P), as well as CryptoBot.

Can I get a refund?

Refunds are available within 24 hours of service activation if the service doesn't meet the declared specifications. See our Terms of Service for full details.

Can I change my plan after ordering?

Yes, you can upgrade your plan anytime through the client panel. Downgrades are possible at the end of the current billing period. Our support team is always ready to help you choose the optimal plan.
